note: Narasi video teknis (TechDemo). Format sama dengan narration-pitch.json: text = teks, tts = ejaan fonetik, speed, pause (detik), gain (dB). Buat ulang: uv run ... gen-voice.py src/tech/narration-tech.json

phrases.text: This is MoveMarket, live on Monad testnet.
phrases.tts: This is Move Market, live on Monad test net.

phrases.text: Everything you see is a real recording of the production app.
A resolver follows a Lichess game, and turns the next few plies into fifteen-second, yes-or-no markets.
phrases.tts: A resolver follows a lee chess game, and turns the next few plies into fifteen-second, yes-or-no markets.

phrases.text: Create account.
The browser makes a passkey, Mera reads its PRF output, and the app derives a standard Ethereum key from it.
phrases.tts: The browser makes a passkey, Mehra reads its P.R.F. output, and the app derives a standard Ethereum key from it.

phrases.text: No seed phrase, no wallet popup. The faucet funds the account, and we approve test USDC once.
phrases.tts: No seed phrase, no wallet pop-up. The faucet funds the account, and we approve test U-S-D-C once.

phrases.text: Under five seconds.
Every four plies, a new batch of markets opens, always about plies that haven't been played yet.
Five on Yes for any capture. Five on No for any check.
Each stake is one synchronous transaction, confirmed in about a second.
Next window: Yes on check, and Yes on capture.
After fifteen seconds, or as soon as the ply before the window is played, the contract locks the pool.
No more stakes.
At ply 112, bishop check.
phrases.tts: At ply one hundred twelve, bishop check.

phrases.text: The resolver runs the shared resolve function and pushes a provisional result to the browser.
Nobody backed the winning side in these two, so they are voided and refunded.
At ply 115, rook takes, with check.
phrases.tts: At ply one hundred fifteen, rook takes, with check.

phrases.text: Provisional Yes, and seconds later, the final result is on-chain.
The final is a Chainlink CRE report: read the markets, fetch the game from Lichess, run the same resolve, and write a signed report to the contract.
phrases.tts: The final is a Chainlink C.R.E. report: read the markets, fetch the game from lee chess, run the same resolve, and write a signed report to the contract.

phrases.text: Here it is on Monadscan: two MarketResolved events, and ReportProcessed from the forwarder.
phrases.tts: Here it is on Monad scan: two Market Resolved events, and Report Processed from the forwarder.

phrases.text: On this hosted deploy, the resolver runs the workflow steps in mock mode, through a forwarder only it can call, until we get DON access.
phrases.tts: On this hosted deploy, the resolver runs the workflow steps in mock mode, through a forwarder only it can call, until we get Don access.

phrases.text: The same workflow, run with the CRE CLI and broadcast, delivered this report through Chainlink's mock Keystone forwarder.
phrases.tts: The same workflow, run with the C.R.E. command line and broadcast, delivered this report through Chainlink's mock Keystone forwarder.

phrases.text: And the LiveMarket contract is verified.
phrases.tts: And the Live Market contract is verified.

phrases.text: Positions are read from the Envio indexer.
phrases.tts: Positions are read from the En-vee-oh indexer.

phrases.text: Claim all settles both winning markets in one transaction. The voided ones refund.
The leaderboard is an Envio query too, and here's the same account, straight from the GraphQL endpoint.
phrases.tts: The leaderboard is an En-vee-oh query too, and here's the same account, straight from the Graph Q.L. endpoint.
